scope: Authored debug-native first-run source states, not production discovery, permission evaluation, recovery, analysis, matching or native accessibility acceptance.
supersedes: The study of prototype a534bf5ac985e091cc93d6c663c24d72ad82a91c, whose explanation ended with a choice to analyse that D84 withdrew.
provenanceNote: The commit and APK digest say what produced the captures. Nothing is checked against them (D88).
analysisText: True peak is measured automatically for every audio file. Analysis uses CPU and battery; playback remains available while it runs.
privacy: Only inspected app-area crops; status strips removed, navigation retained. Raw hierarchies, logs and screenshots stay private.

capture.renderer: Android Emulator OpenGL ES Translator (llvmpipe (LLVM 20.1.2, 256 bits))
capture.note: Views were collected over more than one emulator boot when a boot ended early; each view names its visit. Every view was captured from the same installed APK and checked in its own environment.

lastVisitRestoredRecordedFields.deviceState: Committed state: DeviceState{identifier=2, name='OPENED', app_accessible=true, cancel_when_requester_not_on_top=false}

lifecycle.limitation: Only recorded identifiers and settings are compared; the read-back happens before shutdown.

verificationLimits: Each first view was followed by upward drags until app pixels stopped changing. Where nothing moved, gesture delivery or inability to scroll is not inferred.
A kept end view shows changed app pixels and a displaced body text; it is not a claim about scrolling in general.
Native buttons are debug callbacks only; not picker, Settings or permission-recovery acceptance.
Hierarchy rectangles are not native action or ink bounds.
The explanation of analysis is study copy that no decision chose; D84 decides only that analysis is automatic and not optional. When analysis runs is undecided.
No view moved when dragged, and no hierarchy reported a scrollable container. The superseded study's one state that moved did report one, so the absence is a reading the hierarchy can give.
One view, first-run-access-inner-declined-light-s100.png, shows no gesture handle in the navigation strip. It was the first capture of its visit; the cause was not established.
TalkBack, focus order, speech and contrast were not exercised.
